description: Returns a complete client wired to this room. platform "web" (default): a single-file HTML game with realtime movement plus an anonymous (claimable) player, a saved color (datastore), and a click leaderboard; write it to disk and open it. platform "unity": one drop-in C# script for the Unity C# SDK (Unity 2021.2+) that boots itself on Play in an empty scene (realtime movement, remote smoothing, an event, reconnect hints). The game it is wired to is stamped in a comment at the top of the file.

game.description: Which game to act on: its publishable key (pk_…) or its exact name. Defaults to the x-mp-game header, then your primary game.

platform.description: Client platform: "web" (default, the JS SDK for HTML / any web engine) or "unity" (the C# SDK, Unity 2021.2+).

name: get_client_snippet
title: Get a paste-ready client snippet
